headline: Hamden High School Italian Exchange and China Study trips in April 2027, plus library book and social studies materials discards.
summary: The agenda includes approval of two Hamden High School trips planned for April 2027. It also includes approval of book discards from four media centers and the HPS Social Studies Department materials discards, plus an information item on the library weeding process.
items: Approval of the Hamden High School Italian Exchange trip in April 2027
Approval of the Hamden High School China Study trip in April 2027
Approval of West Woods, Spring Glen, Ridge Hill, and Bear Path Media Center book discards
Approval of HPS Social Studies Department materials discards

ANNOUNCEMENT OF CURRICULUM COMMITTEE ZOOM MEETING 
 
When: October 28, 2026 6:00 PM  
Location: Zoom 
 
To join virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/87877382147?pwd=RmpePEMpB7KuPFZaoKwQVO7PvJClzB.1  
Passcode:594245 
 
Telephone: +1 305 224 1968, 1 309 205 3325, +1 312 626 6799, +1 646 558 8656, +1 646 931 3860  
Webinar ID: 878 7738 2147 
Passcode: 594245 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments:  
Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of the meeting. We ask that public comments be 
limited to no more than 1 minute in length . You may also submit your comment in writing. Public comments 
should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the subject of the message stating the name and date of the 
meeting (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”).  
 
Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message.  
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters).  
• Comments should start with a 2 -3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message in the event that there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety 
would extend beyond the time allotted for public comment.  
• Public comments will be accepted until 1pm the day of the meeting. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
2. Public comments on information and action items 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
4. Information Item: 
a. Library weeding process 
 
5. Action Item: 
a. Approval of the Hamden High School Italian Exchange trip in April 2027 
b. Approval of the Hamden High School China Study trip in April 2027  
c. Approval of West Woods, Spring Glen, Ridge Hill, and Bear Path Media Center book 
discards 
d. Approval of HPS Social Studies Department materials discards 
 
6. Adjournment
